title: review: H8 fix round 5: tests.test_cli Background.test_autostart_true_starts_thread_and_holds_the_lock leaves the autostarted daemon thread running into later tests (breaks test_all_reviews_failed_holds_without_merge); stop and join it in the test, keep the BusSandbox tearDown, prove ordering independence (T-0385 held without commit)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain f43c354, 0751d53, a25898a and bf8898c (T-0360, T-0374, T-0379, T-0382) in git log; never drop or amend them. T-0385 diagnosed the leak but did not commit because the fix was outside its scope; its uncommitted change (an explicit BusSandbox base class with tearDown in tests/test_bus.py, 8 lines) is not on the branch: redo it here.
Measured leaking sequence (T-0385 report): tests.test_cli -> Background.test_autostart_true_starts_thread_and_holds_the_lock -> tests.test_daemon.Daemon.test_all_reviews_failed_holds_without_merge fails with 'failed' != 'held'. The autostarted daemon thread keeps ticking against the later test's sandbox (merge_reviewed marks the task failed before the test's own tick), and it is the source of the stray RuntimeError boom tracebacks seen in gate logs.
Fix: (1) in tests/test_cli.py that test (and any sibling that autostarts the daemon) stops the thread before returning: use the daemon's stop event or flag if one exists (grep daemon.py for stop, running, Event, autostart), otherwise add a minimal stop hook to the autostart path in orchestrator/daemon.py (a threading.Event checked once per loop, exposed for tests, default behaviour unchanged), then join the thread with a timeout in the test or its tearDown and release the daemon lock. (2) Keep the BusSandbox base class and tearDown in tests/test_bus.py from T-0385. (3) Do not change tests/test_daemon.py assertions. Prove: python -m unittest tests.test_cli tests.test_daemon exits 0; then .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root twice in a row, exit 0 both times. git add -A and commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows bf8898c, a25898a, 0751d53 and f43c354 below your commit
python -m unittest tests.test_cli tests.test_daemon in the worktree exits 0 and tests.test_daemon.Daemon.test_all_reviews_failed_holds_without_merge passes with its assertion unchanged
tests/test_cli.py::test_autostart_true_starts_thread_and_holds_the_lock stops and joins the thread it starts (grep shows the join or stop call) and still passes
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree on two consecutive runs
